questions_and_answers.answer: A(t) = A0(1 + rate)t A(t) = total amount due in t years A0 = borrowed amount = $1200 rate = 5% = 0.05 t = years = 5 Plug in the numbers and compute A(t), which is total amount of the loan (principle + interest). To get the monthly payment, divide A(t) by the number of months in 5 years.
